description: Runway ends. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: magnetic headings from a public source (SkyVector), not yet checked against the AIP. Darwin has two runways that cross: 11/29 (3,354 m) and 18/36 (1,524 m, Wikipedia). Headings are in the reference the weather reports use, magnetic. Working: the SkyVector end coordinates give true bearings of about 109 for 11/29 and 180 for 18/36; SkyVector's 106/286 and 177/357 are those less a magnetic variation of about 3 degrees east, and agree with the designations (11 about 110, 29 about 290, 18 about 180, 36 about 360). Runway 36 is written 357, not 0 or 360.
